subject: Retained Anneal V1 orthogonal progress/correctness experiment

observations.name: joint obligations preserve WP.spec strength
observations.detail: Anneal's wp_prove_orthogonal requires both existence of an ok result and postcondition correctness for every ok result. For Aeneas Result, WP.spec is false on fail/div and equals the postcondition on ok, so the two generated obligations jointly suffice for the original WP specification.

observations.name: correctness branch is intentionally conditional and vacuous in isolation
observations.detail: The correctness goal has shape forall y, m = ok y -> P y. If m is fail or div, this implication has no witness and is vacuous. The separate progress goal exists precisely to rule out those executions in the final theorem.

observations.name: diagnostic independence
observations.detail: Generated Lean applies wp_prove_orthogonal before building the Post structure. This lets correctness fields elaborate independently of whether automatic progress can discharge the existential result obligation, preserving field-local diagnostics.

observations.name: progress facts do not flow into correctness
observations.detail: The two goals are sibling proof branches. Facts introduced while proving h_progress are not available in the correctness branch, which receives only the result witness/equality plus ordinary preconditions.

observations.name: proof-context progress limitation
observations.detail: proof context executes on the correctness branch after the split. Its h_returns object is an equality rather than a WP.spec goal, so Aeneas progress tactics cannot be used there. Historical V1 documentation directs operational progress reasoning to proof(h_progress) or individual field proofs.

observations.name: normalization/proof duplication
observations.detail: Independent omitted Post fields use separate autoParam tactics; each verify_is_valid/verify_user_bound invocation independently unfolds and splits h_returns before attempting automation. Shared term-mode proof context can factor ordinary logical setup, but progress tactics cannot be factored there. This trades repeated local proof work for independent diagnostics and order-insensitive fields.

observations.name: allow-sorry magnifies the importance of progress
observations.detail: eval_progress may fall back through Anneal's allow-sorry mechanism when that mode is enabled. Since correctness alone is conditional, admitting progress removes the branch that excludes fail/div. The resulting theorem is therefore only as trustworthy as the explicit admission policy.

observations.name: unsafe(axiom) is separate
observations.detail: The theorem/orthogonal path applies to proof-mode generated theorems. unsafe(axiom) emits an axiom and is covered by a separate completed inventory item, including whether that axiom implies progress.

revalidation_probe.goal: Reproduce historical diagnostics and duplication with the retained exact toolchain.
cases: A function whose Aeneas evaluation is trivial and whose postcondition is false, to show progress succeeds while correctness fails.
A function whose evaluation stalls at an opaque/unsupported step but whose conditional postcondition is trivial, to show correctness can elaborate while progress fails.
The same stalled case with --allow-sorry to demonstrate that admitting progress permits completion without converting conditional correctness into an independent termination proof.
Two omitted Post fields that both require h_returns normalization, to observe repeated autoParam unfolding/splitting and compare with factored proof context.
A proof context that attempts Aeneas progress, confirming the documented post-split limitation and comparing relocation to proof(h_progress).
